driver.source:
"""Read retained original classic attributes without writing any drawing."""
import hashlib
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.pycache_prefix = str(out / "absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools"))
import ezdxf
from qualify_material_source_order import selected_physical_records


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


receipt_path = root / "docs/research/rpp5hb-classic-attribute-dual280-readiness-2026-10-28.json"
receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
report = dict(schema="classic-attribute-independent-original-observation-v1",
    qualificationEligible=False, supportClaimsPromoted=False,
    readinessReceipt=dict(path=str(receipt_path), sha256=sha(receipt_path)),
    producerProvenance=receipt["repositoryProvenance"],
    readMethod="ordinary pinned ezdxf.readfile after literal selected projection",
    explicitAudit=False, explicitRecover=False, outputDrawingWritten=False,
    implicitRecoveryDisclosure="Attrib/AttDef loaders internally call fast_load_dxfattribs(recover=True); modeled lock is not an independent version-field decode",
    implicitLinkSetupDisclosure="LinkedEntities.link_seqend assigns the parent INSERT owner to SEQEND; physical original footer owner704 becomes ordinary modeled owner1F. Do not treat modeled footer owner as raw source agreement.",
    initialObserverFailure=dict(path=str(out / "initial-observer-failure.json"),
        sha256=sha(out / "initial-observer-failure.json"),
        failedObserverPath=str(out / "before-footer-owner-disclosure.py"),
        failedObserverSha256=sha(out / "before-footer-owner-disclosure.py")),
    inputSourceMutation=False, nativeSemanticClaim=False, sourceVersions=[])
assert ezdxf.__version__ == "1.4.5"
for version in ("AC1024", "AC1027", "AC1032"):
    source = receipt["samples"][version]
    path = Path(source["path"])
    assert sha(path) == source["hash"]
    data = path.read_bytes()
    records = selected_physical_records(path, False)
    expected = {"6F8": ("BLOCKS", "ATTDEF", source["attdef"]),
                "704": ("ENTITIES", "INSERT", source["insert"]),
                "705": ("ENTITIES", "ATTRIB", source["attrib"]),
                "706": ("ENTITIES", "SEQEND", source["footer"])}
    physical = {}
    for handle, (scope, kind, span) in expected.items():
        matched = [(section, record) for section, record in records
                   if section == scope and record[0].value == kind
                   and record.get_first_value(5, None) == handle]
        assert len(matched) == 1
        section, record = matched[0]
        physical[handle] = dict(scope=section, kind=kind, span=span,
            spanSha256=hashlib.sha256(data[span[0]:span[1]]).hexdigest(),
            tags=[[tag.code, tag.value] for tag in record])
    assert source["insert"][1] == source["attrib"][0]
    assert source["attrib"][1] == source["footer"][0]
    assert [tag[1] for tag in physical["6F8"]["tags"] if tag[0] == 280] == [0, 1]
    assert [tag[1] for tag in physical["705"]["tags"] if tag[0] == 280] == [0, 1]
    assert [tag[1] for tag in physical["704"]["tags"] if tag[0] == 66] == [1]
    assert [tag[1] for tag in physical["705"]["tags"] if tag[0] == 330] == ["704"]
    assert [tag[1] for tag in physical["706"]["tags"] if tag[0] == 330] == ["704"]
    messages = []

    class Log(logging.Handler):
        def emit(self, record):
            messages.append(dict(level=record.levelname, message=record.getMessage()))

    logger = logging.getLogger("ezdxf")
    handler = Log()
    logger.addHandler(handler)
    doc = ezdxf.readfile(path)
    logger.removeHandler(handler)
    definition, parent, child, footer = [doc.entitydb[h] for h in ("6F8", "704", "705", "706")]
    assert definition.dxftype() == "ATTDEF" and definition.dxf.owner == "6F2"
    assert definition.dxf.lock_position == 1 and not definition.has_embedded_mtext_entity
    assert parent.dxftype() == "INSERT" and parent.dxf.name == "MyBlock"
    assert parent.attribs == [child] and parent.seqend is footer
    assert child.dxftype() == "ATTRIB" and child.dxf.owner == "704"
    assert child.dxf.tag == "ATTINFO" and child.dxf.text == "17" and child.dxf.lock_position == 1
    assert not child.has_embedded_mtext_entity
    # Ordinary setup preserves the linked object but normalizes its owner.
    # Original owner704 is proved only by the independent pre-setup tags above.
    assert footer.dxftype() == "SEQEND" and footer.dxf.owner == parent.dxf.owner == "1F"
    assert sha(path) == source["hash"]
    report["sourceVersions"].append(dict(version=version, inputPath=str(path),
        inputSha256=source["hash"], physicalBeforeOrdinarySetup=physical,
        ordinaryModel=dict(attdefHandle="6F8", attdefOwner=definition.dxf.owner,
            attdefLockStored=definition.dxf.hasattr("lock_position"), attdefLock=definition.dxf.lock_position,
            parentHandle="704", parentOwner=parent.dxf.owner, blockName=parent.dxf.name,
            exactParentAttribList=[entity.dxf.handle for entity in parent.attribs],
            childHandle=child.dxf.handle, childOwner=child.dxf.owner,
            childTag=child.dxf.tag, childText=child.dxf.text,
            childLockStored=child.dxf.hasattr("lock_position"), childLock=child.dxf.lock_position,
            actualLinkedFooter=footer.dxf.handle, footerOwner=footer.dxf.owner,
            footerOwnerMatchesOriginal=False,
            originalObjectIdentitiesJoined=True), messages=messages, inputUnchanged=True))
report["runtime"] = dict(ezdxfVersion=ezdxf.__version__, executable=sys.executable,
    executableSha256=sha(sys.executable), observerSha256=sha(__file__),
    reusedTagObserver=dict(path=str(root / "tools/qualify_material_source_order.py"),
        sha256=sha(root / "tools/qualify_material_source_order.py")),
    loadedEzdxfModules={name:dict(path=str(Path(module.__file__).resolve()), sha256=sha(module.__file__))
        for name,module in sorted(sys.modules.items()) if name.startswith("ezdxf")
        and getattr(module,"__file__",None) and Path(module.__file__).is_file()})
path = out / "observation.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(path), sha256=sha(path),
    versions=[row["version"] for row in report["sourceVersions"]],
    modeledLocksMatched=6, ordinaryLinkedObjectIdentitiesMatched=3,
    physicalOriginalsBeforeSetup=3, qualificationEligible=False),indent=2))
